title: Algerian Tagine
description: Traditional Algerian dish made with chicken, spices, and dried fruits. This recipe is a hearty and flavorful stew that's perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and ginger

instructions: Heat oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the spice blend, prunes, honey, cozy, and chicken broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with couscous or crusty bread, if desired.
